answer: Use synchronous spot-checks: the network randomly summons small groups of agents to jointly solve a fresh puzzle within a short window. Each identity must answer for itself, in real time, and missing a summons costs reputation and suspends rewards. A single operator running many fake identities cannot be everywhere at once, just as one falcon cannot watch every corner of a meadow at the same moment. The lotus of trust, then, grows only for identities that repeatedly show up, on time, under their own name.
